genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07. ZARsc is a rand-referenced payment/settlement token with published issuer or partner 1:1 redemption terms. Current exchange off-ramps should not be confused with the direct Supercoin app redemption planned after app launch; contractual compliance, liquidity and refusal risks remain. Preserve exact issuerEntity Super Money SA (Pty) Ltd (2022/614959/07). Terms claim local FSCA FSP 53458, not independently verified U.S. permission. Resolve authorization unknown to a dated bounded no-public-authorization-found review; foreign registration/comparability remains unknown and no matching public enforcement action was found. Public monthly reserve-report archive and distinct recent monthly PDFs support monthlyAttestationPresent as a disclosure-presence flag, not monthly assurance: Moore August report dated 2026-09-16 expressly is AUP with no assurance opinion/conclusion, and earlier repeated PDF links do not establish separate monthly engagements. No GENIUS approval follows from reserves, FSCA licensing or a parent company listing. General GENIUS regulator sources remain proposal-stage; September 30 SCRC rule is procedural. DASP restrictions are not yet effective at review.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, the consulted primary regulator sources, public directory and issuer disclosures and scoped token/legal-name searches did not identify a token-specific PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official pending GENIUS application or foreign-issuer registration/comparability determination for ZARsc / Super Money SA (Pty) Ltd. This records bounded public negative evidence, not a ruling that the token is unlawful, that no confidential filing exists or that the foreign jurisdiction has been rejected. No matching public enforcement action was located in the scoped searches.
